Fifteen years of building ontrust.

Delivered, not promised

Since 2011 Capstone has valued, sold, leased and managed property across Doha and Lusail — four exclusive projects sold and handed over to their owners, and more than 1,200 units cared for every day.

A bespoke Qatari property company

Capstone Property provides end-to-end valuation, sales, leasing and property management — for the buyers, for the renters, for everyone. We have worked in Qatar's real estate market since 2011, growing into a team of more than 165 people who treat every door we open as a matter of trust.

Independent, RICS-compliant valuation relied on by Qatar's leading banks. Exclusive project sales from launch to handover. Leasing that keeps both sides at ease. Management that keeps buildings and their owners in good standing.

Our Chairman

Late Sheikh Faisal Bin Al Thani

19XX — 20XX

As our Chairman, Sheikh Faisal guided Capstone Property with vision, generosity and quiet strength. He believed that real estate is built on trust, and he led with the same integrity and care that he asked of all of us.

His legacy lives on in every door we open.
